title: Build a Goal-Based Agent Evaluator
description: Construct an evaluation function for an autonomous agent balancing energy consumption against reward.
problemStatement: In an agent-environment loop, an autonomous cleaning robot must evaluate whether to clean a target room. Implement a Python function `evaluate_agent_decision(room_cleanliness, battery_level, room_priority)` that returns `'PROCEED'` if `battery_level >= 20` and either `room_cleanliness < 50` or `room_priority == 'HIGH'`; otherwise it returns `'RECHARGE'` if `battery_level < 20`, or `'STANDBY'` otherwise.
hints: First check if battery is critical (< 20). If so, immediate return 'RECHARGE'.
Then check if the room needs cleaning (< 50) or is high priority.
expectedOutput: 'PROCEED' for dirty room with good battery, 'RECHARGE' for low battery.
